Embedding

A numeric representation used to compare relationships between pieces of content.

In practice

A question about account recovery can match a passage about resetting a password when both use compatible embeddings.

What to check

Keep the original text, source and access scope. Check model and dimension compatibility before reusing an index.

Common confusion

Similarity is not correctness. Embeddings are not encryption or a substitute for access filtering.

# Embedding

A numeric representation used to compare relationships between pieces of content.

## In practice
A question about account recovery can match a passage about resetting a password when both use compatible embeddings.

## What to check
Keep the original text, source and access scope. Check model and dimension compatibility before reusing an index.

## Common confusion
Similarity is not correctness. Embeddings are not encryption or a substitute for access filtering.

## Tell your agent
> Add embeddings to the knowledge base. Retain each passage, document version and access scope. Check model and dimension compatibility, and explain any reindexing required before changing models.
